items.name: theme
items.title: Interlace Theme
items.description: @interlace/ui — full DS CSS baseline: tokens, foundation (type/spacing/radius), preflight (focus ring + min-viewport contract), shadcn↔fumadocs bridge, and brand palette.

items.name: a11y-starter
items.title: A11y Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the three a11y primitives + the reduced-motion hook every consumer should install on day one.

items.name: layout-starter
items.title: Layout Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the six layout primitives that compose every page. One install, the LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY contract is satisfied.

items.name: mdx-starter
items.title: MDX Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the components most MDX pipelines need (Callout, Prose, CodeBlock, Tag), wired through a default mdx-components.tsx.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn — class-name merge utility
items.description: @interlace/ui — the cn() helper, alias-compatible with shadcn. Merges Tailwind class lists deterministically.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion hook
items.description: @interlace/ui — the `useReducedMotion` hook every interactive primitive uses to gate animations on the user's OS preference.

items.name: theme-tokens
items.title: Theme token manifest
items.description: @interlace/ui — the registry of themes and the list of every `--interlace-*` token a theme must define. A missing token does not throw; it silently inherits the previous theme's value.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme hook
items.description: @interlace/ui — reads and writes the theme (`data-theme`) and colour scheme (`.dark`) axes, persists to localStorage, and follows the OS when no preference is stored.

items.name: theme-script
items.title: No-flash theme bootstrap script
items.description: @interlace/ui — the inline `<head>` script that applies the stored theme before first paint. Without it every page load flashes the default theme.
